Delete your Batchwise account

Last updated 2 November 2026

Students, parents' contact details, teachers and staff can ask for their Batchwise account and personal data to be deleted.

In the app

Open the menu, then Profile, then Request account deletion. Your institute's administrator sees the request and deletes the account, normally within 30 days.

Without the app

Ask your institute's office, or email [CONTACT EMAIL] with your name, your institute's name and the mobile number or email you sign in with. We will confirm it is you with your institute before deleting anything.

What is deleted

  • Your sign-in and profile: name, contact details, parent details, photo and notification settings.
  • Your notifications and uploaded files.

What may be kept

Records your institute must keep by law, such as fee receipts, may be kept for the period the law requires and then deleted. Attendance and results may be kept by the institute as part of its academic records. Backups are overwritten within 30 days.
